rules.tl: May shortened link (hal. bit.ly). Tinatago nito kung saan ka talaga dadalhin.
rules.en: Contains a shortened link (e.g. bit.ly) that hides the real destination.
rules.ja: 短縮URL(bit.ly等)があり、本当の行き先が隠されています。

rules.tl: Ang link ay nagpapanggap na brand/gobyerno pero HINDI official domain.
rules.en: The link imitates a brand/government name but is NOT the official domain.
rules.ja: ブランドや政府を装ったリンクですが、公式ドメインではありません。

rules.tl: Ang link ay gumagamit ng domain ending na madalas gamitin sa scam (.top, .xyz, .icu…).
rules.en: The link uses a domain ending often abused by scammers (.top, .xyz, .icu…).
rules.ja: 詐欺でよく使われるドメイン(.top/.xyz/.icu等)です。

rules.tl: Kakaibang link (IP address o punycode).
rules.en: Unusual link (raw IP address or punycode look-alike).
rules.ja: 不自然なリンク(IPアドレスやpunycode)です。

rules.tl: Nagbanggit ng bangko/e-wallet AT may link. Ang GCash, Maya at mga bangko ay hindi nagpapadala ng link para mag-login (AFASA).
rules.en: Mentions a bank/e-wallet AND includes a link. GCash, Maya and banks don't send login links by SMS (AFASA rules).
rules.ja: 銀行/電子ウォレット名とリンクが同時にあります。GCashやMaya、銀行はSMSでログイン用リンクを送りません(AFASA)。

rules.tl: May link sa mensahe. Huwag i-click kung hindi ka sigurado.
rules.en: The message contains a link. Don't tap it unless you're sure.
rules.ja: リンクが含まれています。確信がなければ開かないでください。

rules.tl: Humihingi ng OTP / MPIN / password / code. Walang lehitimong kumpanya ang hihingi nito.
rules.en: Asks for your OTP / MPIN / password / code. No legitimate company asks for these.
rules.ja: OTP・MPIN・パスワード等を求めています。正規の企業は絶対に求めません。

rules.tl: Pinapa-verify o pinapa-update ang account mo.
rules.en: Asks you to verify/update your account details.
rules.ja: アカウントの確認・更新を求めています。

rules.tl: Nananakot na ila-lock, isa-suspend o ma-forfeit ang account/benepisyo.
rules.en: Threatens that your account/benefit will be locked, suspended or forfeited.
rules.ja: アカウント停止・失効などで脅しています。

rules.tl: Minamadali ka (hal. 'within 24 hours', 'ngayon din').
rules.en: Pressures you to act fast (e.g. 'within 24 hours').
rules.ja: 急がせています(「24時間以内」など)。
rules.pattern: \b(within \d+ ?(hours?|hrs?|minutes?|mins?|oras|araw)|\d+ ?(hrs?|oras)|ngayon din|ngayong araw|agad|agad-agad|asap|urgent|immediately|final (notice|warning)|huling paalala|last chance|today only|expire[sd]?|mag-?e-?expire|bago mag|before (midnight|\w+ \d+)|limited slots?)\b

rules.tl: Sinasabing nanalo ka o napili ka sa raffle/promo.
rules.en: Claims you won or were selected for a prize/raffle.
rules.ja: 当選・選ばれたと言っています。

rules.tl: Pinapabayad ka muna ng 'fee' para makuha ang premyo/loan/trabaho/parcel.
rules.en: Asks you to pay a 'fee' first to get a prize/loan/job/parcel.
rules.ja: 賞品・ローン・仕事・荷物のために先に「手数料」を求めています。

rules.tl: Humihingi ng pera o load.
rules.en: Asks you to send money or load.
rules.ja: 送金・ロードを求めています。

rules.tl: Pinapadala sa personal na GCash/Maya number, hindi sa official na account.
rules.en: Payment goes to a personal GCash/Maya number, not an official account.
rules.ja: 公式でない個人のGCash/Maya番号への支払いです。

rules.tl: Alok na trabaho na madali/online/walang experience.
rules.en: Unsolicited easy/online/no-experience job offer.
rules.ja: 簡単・在宅・未経験OKの勧誘です。

rules.tl: Sobrang laking sweldo kada araw para sa simpleng trabaho.
rules.en: Unrealistically high daily pay for simple work.
rules.ja: 簡単な作業に対して高すぎる日給です。

rules.tl: Mukhang 'task scam': mag-like/review tapos pagdedepositohin ka.
rules.en: Looks like a 'task scam': like/review tasks that later require deposits.
rules.ja: 「タスク詐欺」型:いいね・レビュー作業後に入金を要求される手口です。

rules.tl: Pinapalipat ka sa Telegram/WhatsApp o ibang app.
rules.en: Moves you to Telegram/WhatsApp or another app.
rules.ja: Telegram/WhatsApp等へ誘導しています。

rules.tl: 'Parcel on hold' na modus — kunwaring may problema sa padala mo.
rules.en: 'Parcel on hold' pattern — fake delivery problem.
rules.ja: 「荷物保留」型の手口です。

rules.tl: Alok na loan na 'approved na' kahit hindi ka nag-apply.
rules.en: Loan offer 'already approved' that you didn't apply for.
rules.ja: 申し込んでいないのに「承認済み」のローン勧誘です。
rules.pattern: \b(loan|utang|pautang|cash advance|instant cash|pre-?approved|approved na|no collateral|walang collateral|low interest)\b

rules.tl: Nagbabanggit ng ahensya ng gobyerno/ayuda at pinapa-claim o pinapa-register ka.
rules.en: Uses a government agency/ayuda name and asks you to claim or register.
rules.ja: 政府機関・給付金の名前で受取・登録を促しています。

rules.tl: 'Guaranteed' na kita, crypto o investment na sobrang taas ng tubo.
rules.en: 'Guaranteed' returns, crypto, or too-good-to-be-true investment.
rules.ja: 「保証付き」高利回り・暗号資産の投資勧誘です。

rules.tl: Nagpapanggap na kapamilya na may bagong number/emergency.
rules.en: Pretends to be a family member with a new number/emergency.
rules.ja: 新しい番号・緊急事態を装った家族なりすましです。
rules.pattern: \b(bagong number ko|new number ko|new number|nasira (ang )?phone|nawala (ang )?(phone|cellphone)|this is your (son|daughter)|si [A-Z][a-z]+ (ito|'to)|emergency lang|na-?ospital|naaksidente|nahuli ng pulis)\b

rules.tl: Pinapalihim sa iba. Taktika ito para walang makapigil sa iyo.
rules.en: Asks you to keep it secret — so no one can stop you.
rules.ja: 秘密にするよう求めています(止められないようにする手口)。

rules.tl: Pinapa-install ng app/APK o remote-access app (AnyDesk, atbp).
rules.en: Asks you to install an app/APK or remote-access tool (AnyDesk etc).
rules.ja: アプリ/APKや遠隔操作アプリ(AnyDesk等)のインストールを求めています。

rules.tl: Pinapa-scan ng QR code.
rules.en: Asks you to scan a QR code.
rules.ja: QRコードの読み取りを求めています。

rules.tl: Pinapa-reply ng 'YES' — para malaman na active ang number mo.
rules.en: Asks you to reply 'YES' — confirms your number is active.
rules.ja: 「YES」と返信させる手口(番号の有効確認)。

rules.tl: Nagpapanggap na kumpanya/ahensya pero galing sa ordinaryong 09xx number.
rules.en: Claims to be a company/agency but came from a regular 09xx number.
rules.ja: 企業・機関を名乗るのに通常の09xx携帯番号から届いています。

rules.tl: Naglagay ng 'DTI permit' para magmukhang totoo — madaling pekein ito.
rules.en: Cites a 'DTI permit' to look legit — easily faked.
rules.ja: 「DTI許可番号」で本物らしく見せています(簡単に偽造可能)。

rules.tl: Mukhang karaniwang OTP notice na nagsasabing 'huwag ibigay' (binawasan ang score).
rules.en: Looks like a standard OTP notice saying 'never share' (score reduced).
rules.ja: 「共有しないで」という通常のOTP通知に見えます(スコア減算)。

always.tl: Huwag i-click ang link at huwag mag-reply. I-verify gamit ang official app o hotline na ikaw mismo ang naghanap.
always.en: Don't tap links or reply. Verify using the official app or a hotline you look up yourself.
always.ja: リンクを開かず返信もしないでください。自分で調べた公式アプリ・窓口で確認を。

cred.tl: Kung naibigay mo na ang OTP/MPIN: tawagan agad ang bangko/e-wallet gamit ang official hotline sa app nila at ipa-lock ang account.
cred.en: If you already shared an OTP/MPIN: immediately contact your bank/e-wallet via the official hotline in their app and lock the account.
cred.ja: OTP/MPINを教えてしまった場合:すぐ公式アプリ内の窓口で銀行/ウォレットに連絡しアカウントを凍結。

pay.tl: Huwag magpadala ng pera. Kung nakapagpadala na, i-report agad sa GCash/Maya/bangko (in-app Help) at itago ang reference number.
pay.en: Don't send money. If you already did, report it in the GCash/Maya/bank app Help right away and keep the reference number.
pay.ja: 送金しないでください。送金済みなら直ちにGCash/Maya/銀行アプリのヘルプで報告し、参照番号を保管。

job.tl: Ang tunay na trabaho ay hindi ka pagbabayarin para kumita. 'Never pay to get paid.'
job.en: Real jobs never make you pay to earn. Never pay to get paid.
job.ja: 本物の仕事でお金を払わされることはありません。

parcel.tl: I-check ang tracking sa official app/website ng courier (hal. LBC, J&T) — hindi sa link sa text.
parcel.en: Check tracking only in the courier's official app/website (e.g. LBC, J&T) — not via the text's link.
parcel.ja: 追跡は配送会社(LBC、J&T等)の公式アプリ/サイトで。SMSのリンクは使わない。

gov.tl: Ang ayuda ay inaanunsyo sa official na page ng ahensya. Walang bayad ang pag-claim.
gov.en: Government aid is announced on the agency's official page. Claiming never costs a fee.
gov.ja: 給付は機関の公式ページで告知されます。受取に手数料はかかりません。

invest.tl: I-check sa SEC kung rehistrado at may lisensya ang investment. 'Guaranteed' na tubo = red flag.
invest.en: Check with the SEC whether the investment is registered and licensed. 'Guaranteed' returns = red flag.
invest.ja: SECで登録・許可を確認。「利回り保証」は危険信号。

family.tl: Tawagan ang kapamilya sa LUMANG number niya o magtanong ng bagay na kayo lang ang nakakaalam.
family.en: Call the family member on their OLD number or ask something only they would know.
family.ja: 家族の「以前の番号」に電話するか、本人しか知らない質問を。

loan.tl: Mag-loan lang sa SEC-registered na lending company. Walang bayad bago ma-release ang loan.
loan.en: Only borrow from SEC-registered lenders. No fee should be paid before release.
loan.ja: SEC登録の貸金業者のみ利用。融資前の手数料は不要。

report.tl: I-report: CICC Hotline 1326 (24/7) • report@cicc.gov.ph • eGovPH app → Report. I-forward/i-block ang number.
report.en: Report: CICC Hotline 1326 (24/7) • report@cicc.gov.ph • eGovPH app → Report. Block the number.
report.ja: 通報:CICCホットライン1326(24時間)• report@cicc.gov.ph • eGovPHアプリ→Report。番号はブロック。
